text:
alex.k: Quick async — microcopy + benchmarks for the launch post. Short format please. What I did / blockers / today?
maria: Drafted the microcopy for the benchmark post and pulled the initial results chart. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/microcopy-draft. Blocker: need eng to confirm event names for tracking and whether the model label is `gpt-large` or `gpt-xl`.
jen: Added calendar slots — copy freeze Friday 10am PT. Uploaded social card variants to the Figma file. Need an eng sanity check on the tracking snippet and confirmation there’s no PII.
sam: @jen I can take a look after 1pm PT today. Share the snippet here and I’ll validate.
jen: Snippet is below: `window.rwTrack('bench_view', { model: 'gpt-large', test_id: 'bench-2026-03' })` — plan is to keep telemetry minimal.
liam: Microcopy suggestion: use "performance snapshot" instead of "benchmark results" for friendlier tone. Also add alt text for social cards — I can add a short line per card.
maria: Updated doc with liam wording suggestion and alt text. Question: are we standardizing on telemetry `v1` or `v2` keys?
sam: We should use `v2` moving forward. I checked and `bench_view` is fine, no PII. I’ll open a PR to register the event in infra-tracking.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy started for `marketing/bench-page` at 1865432130
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded — https://staging.redwood.ai/bench (staging)
alex.k: Great. Action items: maria — finalize microcopy following liam’s phrasing; jen — lock calendar slot and confirm social copy to design; sam — open PR and ping here when merged; liam — small PR for alt text if you want. I’ll assemble the launch checklist after lunch.
maria: Will finalize and push updates by 5pm PT.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-tracking/pull/482 — tagging @infra for review.
jen: Calendar locked. Social copy moving to design for final art.
alex.k: Thanks all :thumbsup:
